node.name: Medium_Experience_Balloon
node.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

quest:Cactolyte3.name: Peanut_De-Aging
quest:Cactolyte3.description: Defeat Biggie Hours with this peanut in your inventory. Don't drop it, or it'll decay to dust in 5 seconds flat!

quest:Tiki_Chief3.name: Blame_it_on_the_Glublins
quest:Tiki_Chief3.description: Clear out some Goblins, and totally invite everyone again!

quest:Snake_Jar3.name: PSA._You_Are_Being_Eaten!
quest:Snake_Jar3.description: Wait, why do they want to pretend to have eaten you again? Uh oh, I don't like the look of that Quest Helper...

quest:Wellington3.name: You_Can't_Run,_but_you_Can_Hide
quest:Wellington3.description: Give up on your search for the Maestro Blobulyte by saying 'Darn you, Blobulyte! Why must you hide like a coward'

quest:Dazey2.name: Literally_Physics
quest:Dazey2.description: Get some woodular circles from branches, and do something with them? I don't go to Dazey's school either, I'm as confused as you are.

quest:Cowbo_Jones12.name: Children?_What'd_they_ever_do_for_Me...
quest:Cowbo_Jones12.description: Donate to the Starving Orphan Monsters foundation in the Cauldron.

quest:Bill_Brr1.name: Fairly_Odd_Damage
quest:Bill_Brr1.description: Deal an 'odd' amount of damage 8 times in a row.

quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt2.name: Frogecoin_to_the_MOON!
quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt2.description: Go trap Froge Critters, found in the SLIME map in Blunder Hills.

item:Quest48.name: Pete_the_Peanut
item:Quest48.description: Now that's a happy looking peanut! I wish he was MY best friend, but no one wants to be friends with sentient item dialogue ^

item:Crystal2.name: Glacier_Quartz
item:Crystal2.description: Restores power to the Glacial Portal in the desert town, allowing travel to World 3!

item:PremiumGem.name: Gem
item:PremiumGem.description: Hold down to add these gems to your account. You can then spend them in the Gem Shop!

item:NPCtoken14.name: Dazey_Token
item:NPCtoken14.description: Proof that you completed all of Dazey's quests! Hold down to add to your token bag found in Storage Info. DONT SELL THIS ITEM

item:Quest41.name: Flowies
item:Quest41.description: Curse you flowey! I trusted you, I accepted your pellets of friendship, and then you had to go and throw it all away! And now here you are, trying to take over yet another video game... well I NOT GONNA LE-- oh wait, these are just normal flowers

item:TreeInterior1b.name: Woodular_Circle
item:TreeInterior1b.description: Made of circle that's been carved into the shape of a wood. NOTE: This is a very rare drop from Branches

item:NPCtoken32.name: Hoggi_Token
item:NPCtoken32.description: Proof that you completed all of Hoggindaz's quests! Hold down to add to your token bag, found in Storage Info. DONT SELL THIS ITEM

item:Timecandy3.name: 4_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy3.description: Hold down to instantly get 4 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:Critter1.name: Froge
item:Critter1.description: The living embodiment of the classic cryptocurrency 'Frogecoin'. Very ribbit, much green, wow!!

item:Critter1A.name: Poison_Froge
item:Critter1A.description: Ew, it's the living embodiment of that scam alt-coin crypto ripoff, 'Frogecoin Cash'
